title: Factor gtimeout-first probe into shared helper and lint for bare timeout
goal: Replace six hand-copied gtimeout-first probes with a single shared helper in scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh, convert all six sites to use it, and add a lint that fails on any bare `timeout` call in core/, scripts/, or plugins/.

steps.description: Write the bare-timeout lint test first (TDD red step). Creates a fixture tree with a planted bare `timeout` call, runs the not-yet-existing lint against it, and asserts rc=1. A second assertion runs the lint against a clean fixture and asserts rc=0. A third assertion verifies that a `# lint-bare-timeout:allow` exemption suppresses the finding. Confirms the test fails before any implementation exists.

Write the shared-helper regression tests (TDD red step). Two fixtures: (a) a synthetic PATH containing only a recording `gtimeout` shim (no `timeout` binary) — verifies that after calling `_acceptance_timeout_prefix`, the emitted command uses gtimeout; (b) a PATH with neither binary — verifies `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT` is empty and the helper returns 0 (no false pass, caller runs unbounded). Also includes the #1532 inert_build regression: a genuinely failing acceptance testfile still yields inert_build after the helper is shared. Uses a PATH shim, not `test-helpers.sh:374`'s mock, per the constraint.

Create scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh. Move `_acceptance_timeout_prefix` verbatim from acceptance-block.sh into this file (function body unchanged, keeping the `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT` output contract and the `_ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT_KILL_OK` once-per-process cache). Add a file header citing #1752 and ADR-036. No other functions; callers that need only the binary build their own array from `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT`.

Update scripts/lib/acceptance-block.sh: remove the `_acceptance_timeout_prefix` function definition (lines ~359–381) and replace it with a guard-sourced `source` of scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh (matching the pattern already used in plugins/agent/build/lib/summary.sh:23-25 for idempotent sourcing). The function's name, the `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT` contract, and the `_ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT_KILL_OK` cache variable are all preserved — only the definition site moves.

Update core/router/route.sh at both probe sites (lines ~1046 and ~1943). Remove the 3-line inline `if command -v gtimeout / elif command -v timeout` block at each site. Add a guard-source of scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh near the top of the file (once). At each call site, replace the inline probe with `_acceptance_timeout_prefix "$_local_secs"` (sync) and `_acceptance_timeout_prefix "$_iter_local_secs"` (loop), then assign `_tout_cmd=("${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]+"${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]}"}")`. rc semantics (124/137) are unchanged; the router sites gain `-k` support from the shared helper, which is a safe improvement.

Update scripts/run-tests.sh. Remove the 12-line inline probe+array-build block starting at line ~34 (the `_rt_tout_bin` declaration through the closing `fi`). Add a guard-source of scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh. Replace the block with `_acceptance_timeout_prefix "$_RT_FILE_TIMEOUT"` and `_rt_tout=("${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]+"${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]}"}")`. The `_RT_KILL_GRACE` variable is superseded by the helper's `ZBUILD_NEGCTL_KILL_GRACE` env var (same default: 10); ensure the env var is set or pass a local override.

Update scripts/run-mutation.sh. Remove the 16-line inline probe+array-build block starting at line ~124 (the `_mut_tout_bin` declaration through the closing `fi`). Add a guard-source of scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh. Replace with `_acceptance_timeout_prefix "$_MUT_TEST_TIMEOUT"` and `_mut_tout=("${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]+"${_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT[@]}"}")`. Same kill-grace env-var alignment as step-6.

Update scripts/lib/gh-automation.sh. Remove the 6-line inline probe block at line ~191 (the `timeout_cmd` string variable declaration through the closing `fi`). Add a guard-source of scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh. Replace with `_acceptance_timeout_prefix "$timeout_val"` and build the invocation from `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT`. (gh-automation.sh previously had no `-k` probe; the shared helper adds it, consistent with the other sites.)

Create scripts/lib/lint-bare-timeout.sh. Scans core/, scripts/, plugins/ for bare `timeout ` word-boundary occurrences in *.sh files (not `gtimeout`, not inside comments). Per-line opt-out: `# lint-bare-timeout:allow: <reason>`. Exempts scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh with an inline comment in the lint explaining why (the mock is a `timeout` that just execs — exempt to avoid false positives). Exempts this lint file itself (self-reference). Also add `# lint-bare-timeout:allow: release tooling (Initiative 1.1) — behavior fix out of scope for #1752` to scripts/release.sh line 629 so the lint covers it explicitly rather than silently skipping.
Wire the new lint into package.json by appending `&& bash scripts/lib/lint-bare-timeout.sh` to the `lint` script string. This makes `npm run lint` enforce the bare-timeout rule in CI and locally.

Amend docs/adr/ADR-036-acceptance-contract-teeth.md with a dated amendment paragraph stating: every timeout bound in core/, scripts/, and plugins/ is resolved through `_acceptance_timeout_prefix` (scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh); a bare `timeout` call is a lint failure. Add an `## Enforced by` section naming scripts/lib/lint-bare-timeout.sh and tests/unit/lint-bare-timeout-test.sh per CLAUDE.md/#2268. This satisfies the ADR-036 amendment acceptance criterion.

notes: Key constraints verified in code: (1) `_acceptance_timeout_prefix` keeps its name and `_ACCEPTANCE_TOUT`/`_ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT_KILL_OK` contract — plugins/agent/build/lib/summary.sh:23,433 sources and calls it directly. (2) route.sh sites currently have no `-k` probe; the shared helper adds it, which is a safe improvement (a killed-timeout still yields rc=137, unchanged). (3) `scripts/release.sh:629` is a bare `timeout` in release tooling; fixing its behavior is explicitly out of scope per the issue; it gets an inline `# lint-bare-timeout:allow` exemption comment. (4) The no-`timeout`-host test MUST NOT use the `test-helpers.sh:374` mock (it ignores duration and just execs); it must use a PATH-resident recording shim. (5) Conflict with #1730 in `route_to_model_loop` — the issue notes this textually; the plan should be landed after #1730 or before it with a coordination note, but the plan itself is not blocked. (6) `_acceptance_timeout_prefix` is guard-sourced by summary.sh using a `declare -F` pattern (lines 23-25) — the same guard-source pattern should be used everywhere to avoid double-definition errors. (7) `run-tests.sh` and `run-mutation.sh` use a local kill-grace variable (`_RT_KILL_GRACE`, `_MUT_KILL_GRACE`) backed by env vars; after refactoring, the shared helper reads `ZBUILD_NEGCTL_KILL_GRACE` (default 10) — step-6/7 must ensure the caller exports the right env var or that the defaults align (both default to 10, so no behavioral change on default paths). Gap: the exact guard-source path arithmetic for `timeout-cmd.sh` in `route.sh` (which lives under `core/`) needs to be verified at implementation time — the path `$(dirname ${BASH_SOURCE[0]})/../../scripts/lib/timeout-cmd.sh` or similar.
